text: 金十数据10月10日讯，财政部拟第二次续发行2026年记账式附息（十七期）国债。本次续发行国债为3年期固定利率附息债。本次续发行国债竞争性招标面值总额1200亿元，进行甲类成员追加投标。本次续发行国债票面利率与之前发行的同期国债相同，为1.23%。本次续发行国债的起息日、兑付安排与之前发行的同期国债相同。自2026年8月25日开始计息，按年付息，每年8月25日（节假日顺延，下同）支付利息，2029年8月25日偿还本金并支付最后一次利息。招标时间2026年10月16日上午10:35至11:35。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — The Ministry of Finance plans a second continuation issuance of the 2026 book-entry interest-bearing treasury bonds (seventeenth tranche). This continuation issuance is a 3-year fixed-rate interest-bearing bond. The competitive bidding face value total for this continuation issuance is 120 billion yuan, with additional bidding by Class A members. The coupon rate of this continuation issuance is the same as that of the previously issued bonds of the same tenor, at 1.23%. The value date and repayment arrangements of this continuation issuance are the same as those of the previously issued bonds of the same tenor. Interest begins accruing on August 25, 2026, with annual interest payments on August 25 each year (postponed for holidays, the same below), and principal repayment and the final interest payment on August 25, 2029. Bidding time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on October 16, 2026.
